name: our-game-shelf
description: Connect Four, Battleships, Hues, Quickfire, Word Wheel, Word Slam and Sharp Wits on the watercolour game shelf.

scripts.check: for f in public/js/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: node tools/firebase-config.mjs --stub && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-gameshelf "node tests/e2e/phone-layout.mjs && node tests/e2e/two-players.mjs && node tests/e2e/hues-bugs.mjs && node tests/e2e/quickfire.mjs && node tests/e2e/wordwheel.mjs && node tests/e2e/slam.mjs && node tests/e2e/sharpwits.mjs && node tests/e2e/bot.mjs && node tests/e2e/wake-lock.mjs"
scripts.test:unit: node tests/unit/replay.mjs && node tests/unit/hues.mjs && node tests/unit/quickfire.mjs && node tests/unit/wordwheel-data.mjs && node tests/unit/wordwheel.mjs && node tests/unit/stats.mjs && node tests/unit/table-history.mjs && node tests/unit/slam.mjs && node tests/unit/sharpwits.mjs && node tests/unit/bot-c4.mjs && node tests/unit/bot-bs.mjs && node tests/unit/bot-hu.mjs && node tests/unit/bot-qf.mjs && node tests/unit/bot-ww.mjs && node tests/unit/bot-sl.mjs && node tests/unit/bot-sw.mjs
